history_summary: Add the species-name GTDB correspondence for the existing Bacillus vallismortis RW8 descriptor
history_details: Preserve the two-strain HT identity and the distinct RW5 mapping. The native species-name fallback for Bacillus vallismortis reproduces one reference genome and fraction 1.0; it does not assign an assembly to study stock RW8. OQ996934 remains 16S evidence, not a genome accession. Only taxonomy[1] GTDB block/status and two native inline events changed. Existing source quotations, three biological endpoints, lack of causal arrows, uncertainty and prior history remain unchanged. Scoped database and provenance correction; full scientific approval and corpus QC are separate.
